desc:
A sticky chocolate pit, thousands of candy keycaps, and one giant pyramid to finish… can your server build it together? 🤝

How to play:
🍫 Pick up keycaps from the chocolate pit 
🏃Carry them to the pyramid 
⚡ Train your strength and your speed 
🏆Complete the pyramid all together 

🔥 Like 👍 + Join the Group ⭐ = FREE SPEED

Inspired by "Build the Pyramid!"

Tags: build, keyboard, pyramid, candy, chocolate, speed
